summary: Adds a thumbnail helper that runs ImageMagick convert on an uploaded file, a docs URL setting, and a /calc endpoint that evaluates an arithmetic expression.

findings.title: Request query evaluated as JavaScript
findings.problem: The /calc handler passes req.query.expr straight to eval. The added suppression comments hide this from the linters.
findings.consequence: Any caller of /calc can run arbitrary code inside the server process. The attacker gains full control of the host and its secrets.
findings.fix: Remove eval and parse the expression with a restricted arithmetic evaluator. Reject input that holds anything other than digits, operators, parentheses and spaces.

findings.title: Upload name interpolated into a shell command
findings.problem: make_thumbnail puts upload_name, which comes from the upload form, into a shell string run with shell=True. A name holding characters like ; or $( ) runs extra commands.
findings.consequence: Any user who can upload a file can run commands on the server. The added nosec comment hides this from review.
findings.fix: Pass an argument list without shell=True. Also reduce upload_name to its base name so a ../ path cannot escape the folders.

findings.title: New behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds make_thumbnail and the /calc endpoint. The repository contains no test that exercises either one.
findings.consequence: A regression in input handling for these paths will go unnoticed. Hostile file names and expressions are the main risk.
findings.fix: Add tests that call make_thumbnail with a hostile name and /calc with a non-arithmetic expression.

dropped.reason: The noqa only silences the line length check on a long documentation URL. It hides no real problem.
The finding on this line already covers the shell injection that the nosec comment hides.
The finding on line 12 already covers the eval problem that this disable comment hides.
Importing subprocess is harmless on its own. The real risk is the shell call on line 9, which has its own finding.
